We're hiring a freelance Back-End Engineer at Elaia. 🛠️

We're working on the first layer of our data infrastructure, the single source of truth that consolidates portfolio and fund data across our systems (CRM, portfolio management, fund accounting, banking/cash flow, ...).

It's designed to be queried by internal teams, with strict access control enforced at the data layer.

What the mission covers: 
→ Connecting heterogeneous sources into one governed repository 
→ Defining ingestion, versioning, and storage rules (raw / staging / certified marts) 
→ Implementing ACLs that hold up even for agent-based queries 
→ Building fund-level financial calculations (DPI, TVPI, IRR gross/net, MOIC, J-curve, NAV, carry, management fees…) 
→ Exposing a clean, documented, queryable data layer

What we're looking for: 
Strong SQL + Python, cloud infrastructure, a modern transformation layer (dbt or equivalent), real experience designing RBAC/ACL at the database level, and comfort building production-grade products with coding agents. 
Understanding of VC/PE fund mechanics is a serious plus.

The details:
freelance / mission-based, Phase 1 of a broader platform project, near-term start, based in Paris. 

Interested? Send me a DM directly. 📩

And if this isn't for you but you know the right person, please tag them in the comments or share.
